title: The Ribbon Has a Name
hook: I-5, then I-90. The kit is in the box.
scene: The Ledger is parked on a wide paved shoulder just before the I-5 south ramp, engine still, key in. Overcast midday. Clipboard on the doghouse between the seats. The log line is I-5 south, I-90 east, valley floor only. CARGO is the relay kit that already fit in the Menace: repeater set, antenna, mast clamps, lashed in the cargo box. Ali is in the jump seat. Mya is a loaf on the dash because the wheels are not turning. The mountain sits in the east as a shape, not a road. The schedule does not climb today.
debrief: Parked: cluster at zero, clipboard on the doghouse between the seats, Mya on the dash. The kit is in the box. The log stops at the valley floor.

source.teaching_target: Establish the Ribbon and the locked load: relay kit (repeater, antenna, mast clamps) that fits the existing Menace, riding in the Ledger box.

image_brief.subject: Deac chest-up in the parked Ledger, amber vest, glasses on the cord, thermos in one hand
image_brief.foreground: dulled amber vest tape at the shoulder, clipboard edge on his thigh
image_brief.midground: bar cage and still wipers, no motion in the glass
image_brief.background: overcast midday shoulder, I-5 ramps soft and distant, no snow, no night
image_brief.read: Deac is parked; the wheels are still; the mountain is only a distant shape
extra_negatives: no antenna mounted as a new Ledger mark
